propositions: attach_commits rejects valid code commit SHAs when REBAR_TRACKER_DIR relocates ticket storage outside the code checkout because code_root_for derives the code repository from dirname(tracker) instead of the actual code root.
Commit validation must resolve code SHAs against the code repository (via explicit repo_root, REBAR_ROOT, or cwd Git top-level) independently from tracker storage location.
code_root_for and unresolvable_shas functions are obsolete after resolution and must be removed to prevent reintroduction of the tracker-parent-derived code root pattern.
Unknown/invalid commit SHAs must remain all-or-nothing rejections that record no partial COMMITS event, regardless of tracker storage location.
